name: kb_373_Normalized

https:__kubernetesjsonschema_dev_master_.description: IDRange provides a min/max of an allowed range of IDs.

max.description: max is the end of the range, inclusive.

min.description: min is the start of the range, inclusive.

schema.description: FSGroupStrategyOptions defines the strategy type and options used to create the strategy.

ranges.description: ranges are the allowed ranges of fs groups.  If you would like to force a single fs group then supply a single range with the same start and end. Required for MustRunAs.

rule.description: rule is the strategy that will dictate what FSGroup is used in the SecurityContext.

description: The filesystem group strategy for this policy is set to **MustRunAs**, which means any pod must explicitly specify an FSGroup that falls within the approved ranges. Two allowable intervals have been defined: the first permits any group identifier from **1000** through **2000**, inclusive; the second restricts the group to the single value **3000**. Pods that do not conform to either of these ranges will be rejected by the admission controller.
